reviewer: Kimi Code recovery final-alpha review subagent actually viewed the full exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, native-resolution parent/derived detail regions, full final white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet, and unchanged naiwa.png reference; independently verified the repair receipt, source/parent/derived/evidence/sheet hashes, unchanged RGB bytes, in-memory BILINEAR alpha equality, resized-alpha hash, corners and metadata with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The final derivative preserves the approved parent RGB exactly. The yellow compact round mascot retains short gray sideburns and two light-gray eyebrows, green-ringed solid black eyes, one friendly closed-mouth smile, no human skin, nose or ears, and no added glasses, moustache or beard. The near-frontal slight image-left pose and gaze, soft warm light and original bust crop remain recognizable. The navy peaked cap retains one upper gold eagle, one lower dark-centered gold wreath/cockade, black visor, gold cords and oakleaf band. The navy jacket, white pointed shirt collar, dark tie and one suspended black-and-silver throat cross remain without added decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The pale gray-greige mottled backplate fills the complete rectangle; no frame, note, halo or replacement scene was invented. Full final white/cyan/alpha viewing shows solid clothing and backing without interior holes, exterior cutouts or matte rings.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the derived RGBA for production. The exact source and final output both have measured alpha extrema [255,255], and source/resized/output corner arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Independent read-only comparison confirms final RGB bytes equal the approved parent and final alpha bytes equal the source alpha resized to 1776x2368 with BILINEAR; resized_alpha_sha256 is 11e122a90e29c4446b6c237e34e49cbf168d719980366098d97c5453f58620c1. The full sheet confirms a legitimately opaque rectangular portrait; cyan panel-edge strips are letterboxing, not output transparency. This is a derived alpha-repaired output, not a native transparent return.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210 the fine cap-badge and oakleaf interiors and the small neck-cross suspension details cannot be transcribed reliably. Their visible counts and placements were checked without inventing microscopic detail, and these evidence limits are not rejection grounds.
